summary: Rocket Lab Corp files 8-K on June 28, 2026 regarding entry into Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Iridium Communications Inc. Iridium shareholders will receive $27.00 cash plus a variable stock component based on Rocket Lab's stock price: if $67.50 or less, exchange ratio is 0.4000; if between $67.50 and $112.50, ratio floats; if $112.50 or more, ratio is 0.2400. Transaction is structured as two-step merger intended as tax-free reorganization if conditions met. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for regulatory clearance and stock price movement affecting consideration mix.
